title: Japan Pledges Drones, Coastal Defense Radar in Latest Philippine Defense Package
zh_title: 日本承诺在菲律宾最新的国防计划中提供无人机和海防雷达
summary: BRP Jose Rizal 与两艘日本海上自卫队舰艇进行演习。菲律宾海军照片 日本将在东京最新的防御计划中向菲律宾军方转让无人机和海岸防御雷达系统，以增强马尼拉的军队。日本驻菲律宾大使北川胜郎和菲律宾外交部长特蕾莎·拉扎罗周一签署了一项协议，涵盖通过官方安全援助计划提供价值高达 2700 万美元的防务转移。此次援助标志着首次通过
content:
BRP Jose Rizal 与两艘日本海上自卫队舰艇进行演习。菲律宾海军照片 日本将在东京最新的防御计划中向菲律宾军方转让无人机和海岸防御雷达系统，以增强马尼拉的军队。日本驻菲律宾大使北川胜郎和菲律宾外交部长特蕾莎·拉扎罗周一签署了一项协议，涵盖通过官方安全援助计划提供价值高达 2700 万美元的防务转移。据日本外务省周一发布的新闻稿称，此次援助标志着首次通过专用海岸雷达系统向菲律宾转移国防设备。该雷达将由菲律宾海军操作，菲律宾海军是日本类似监视系统的先前接收者。上个月在马尼拉举行的日本自卫队成立 72 周年招待会上，日本公司展示了各种打算出售或转让给菲律宾军方的海岸监视系统。这些雷达包括能够跟踪 24 海里外船只的短程系统，以及能够感知 140 海里外海上目标的功能更强大的多用途雷达。除了海域意识援助外，菲律宾空军还将接收型号和数量不详的无人机。 2025年夏天，东京通过OSA向马来西亚转让了14架Aerobo Wing AS-VT02A无人机，价值高达270万美元。
此次移交是马尼拉和东京之间的首次无人移交。此前，日本将TC-90涡轮螺旋桨飞机移交给菲律宾海军航空联队用于海上巡逻。日本大使馆的新闻稿称：“该项目对于进一步促进日本和菲律宾之间的安全合作、加强日本重要海上通道的安全以及维护和加强地区和平与稳定具有重要意义。”近年来，由于对南中国海和吕宋海峡的共同担忧，东京与马尼拉寻求更密切的防务关系。自 2010 年代以来一些最重要的进展包括承诺为菲律宾海岸警卫队提供 17 艘巡逻舰，以及日本自卫队作战部队抵达东南亚群岛进行演习。今年，日本军队与美国、菲律宾和加拿大军队一起演习，保卫吕宋岛北部的海滩。东京首次全面实战演习以在击沉演习中发射反舰导弹而达到高潮。新的国防装备转让指南也为前日本自卫队装备出售或转让给菲律宾军方开辟了新的机会。目前正在讨论将即将退役的阿巴库巴级护卫舰转移给菲律宾海军。

【原文 English Original】
BRP Jose Rizal conducts exercises with two Japan Maritime Self-Defense ships. Philippine Navy photo Japan will transfer unmanned aerial vehicles and a coastal defense radar system to the Philippine military in Tokyo’s latest defense package to bolster Manila’s forces. Japanese Ambassador to the Philippines Katsuro Kitagawa and Philippine Secretary of Foreign Affairs Theresa Lazaro signed an agreement on Monday covering the defense transfer worth up to $27 million via the Official Security Assistance program. The assistance marks the first transfer of defense equipment to the Philippines via a dedicated coastal radar system, as classified by a Japanese Ministry of Foreign Affairs news release published on Monday. This radar will be operated by the Philippine Navy, which has been the previous recipient of similar surveillance systems from Japan. At the 72nd Japan Self-Defense Force anniversary reception in Manila last month, Japanese firms showcased a variety of coastal watch systems intended for sale or transfer to the Philippine military. These ranged from short-range systems capable of tracking vessels out to 24 nautical miles to more capable multirole radars that can sense maritime targets 140 nautical miles away. Alongside the maritime domain awareness assistance, the Philippine Air Force will receive an unspecified variant and quantity of UAVs. In the summer of 2025, Tokyo transferred 14 Aerobo Wing AS-VT02A UAVs worth up to $2.7 million to Malaysia through OSA. The latest transfer is the first instance of unmanned transfers between Manila and Tokyo. Previously, Japan handed over TC-90 turboprops to the Philippine Naval Air Wing for maritime patrols. “This project is of great importance in further promoting security cooperation between Japan and the Philippines, enhancing security of important sea lanes for Japan, and contributing to maintaining and strengthening regional peace and stability,” reads the Japanese Embassy release. In recent years, Tokyo has pursued closer defense relations with Manila amid mutual concerns over the South China Sea and Luzon Strait. Some of the most significant developments since the 2010s include the commitment of 17 patrol ships for the Philippine Coast Guard and the arrival of Japan Self-Defense Force combat troops for drills across the Southeast Asian archipelago. This year, Japanese troops drilled alongside American, Philippine and Canadian forces to defend a beach in Northern Luzon. Tokyo’s full-scale combat exercise debut culminated with the launch of anti-ship missiles at a sinking exercise. New defense equipment transfer guidelines are also opening up new opportunities for ex-JSDF equipment to be sold or transferred to the Philippine military. Discussions are ongoing to transfer soon-to-be retired Abakumba-class destroyer escorts to the Philippine Navy.

title: U.S. Transfers Unmanned Surface Vessels to Philippine Marine Corps
zh_title: 美国向菲律宾海军陆战队转让无人水面舰艇
summary: 一艘 MARTAC Devil Ray T38 无人水面舰艇。 MARTAC 照片 菲律宾海军陆战队上周在苏比克湾接收了两艘美国制造的无人水面舰艇，这是华盛顿加强马尼拉在南中国海和吕宋海峡的不对称能力的努力的一部分。 11月4日，两艘海上战术系统T38魔鬼鱼无人水面艇被转移到苏比克湾的菲律宾海军陆战队。 PMC 部表示：“今天标志着我们继续努力加强菲律宾海军陆战队能力的又一个有意义的步骤，特别是在群岛海岸防御领域。”
content:
一艘 MARTAC Devil Ray T38 无人水面舰艇。 MARTAC 照片 菲律宾海军陆战队上周在苏比克湾接收了两艘美国制造的无人水面舰艇，这是华盛顿加强马尼拉在南中国海和吕宋海峡的不对称能力的努力的一部分。 11月4日，两艘海上战术系统T38魔鬼鱼无人水面艇被转移到苏比克湾的菲律宾海军陆战队。菲律宾海军陆战队副司令准将说：“今天标志着我们在不断努力加强菲律宾海军陆战队能力方面又迈出了有意义的一步，特别是在群岛海岸防御领域。”根据美国海军学院新闻提供的文字记录，巴亚尼·库拉明将军出席了仪式。据美国海军学院新闻六月报道，菲律宾海军陆战队被定为继菲律宾海军之后下一支接收无人机的部队。马尼拉海军陆战队处于南海争端的最前线，驻守着被大批中国正规军和准军事部队包围的前哨基地。一位熟悉此事的美国国防官员也强调了菲律宾陆军通过该计划接收无人机的可能性。据美国海军学院新闻了解，该部队正在寻求扩大其群岛海岸防御计划中监测和控制受威胁目标的能力。近年来，菲律宾海军陆战队装备了布拉莫斯岸防巡航导弹，并被部署到从苏禄海到吕宋海峡的战略海上交通线上。
横须贺亚太研究委员会东南亚区域项目主任查理·布朗告诉美国海军学院新闻，无人机转移使海军陆战队能够“在广阔且竞争日益激烈的海域”保持意识。布朗说：“这是建立可信的群岛防御能力的一个重要因素：不一定要与对手的平台相匹配，而是利用技术、信息共享和分布式能力使菲律宾的海上途径更加透明，其领土防御更具弹性。”在马尼拉和北京之间因南海争议领土问题出现一系列紧张局势之后，五角大楼正在做出更广泛的努力，以增强菲律宾的领海意识。 2023年以来，中菲军队多次围绕对方声称拥有主权的多个浅滩和岛礁发生冲突。马尼拉为对抗中国军队而进行的新生现代化努力得到了美国和日本越来越多的支持。总部位于佛罗里达州的海上无人机制造商 Maritime Tactical Systems, Inc. 很早就被任命为菲律宾海军提供第一批无人水面航行器。目前，海军第一支无人水面航行器的核心由一艘 T38 Devil Ray 和四艘 MANTIS T12 组成。海军陆战队无人水面艇被转移到 MARTAC 的新苏比克湾设施。
根据该公司发布的消息，该无人机卓越中心旨在培训菲律宾无人机操作员并为“魔鬼鱼”储备零部件。MARTAC 发布的消息称：“该中心还将为当地创造就业机会和建立合作伙伴关系，以增强菲律宾在未来几年部署大型 USV 舰队的能力。”今年夏天，总部位于密西西比州的自主 USV 公司 Ocean Aero, Inc. 向菲律宾海军交付了四架 Triton 无人机。美国-菲律宾倡议目前的重点是提供海域意识能力，以解决东南亚群岛周围的重大差距

【原文 English Original】
A MARTAC Devil Ray T38 unmanned surface vessel. MARTAC photo The Philippine Marine Corps received two American-made unmanned surface vessels last week at Subic Bay as part of Washington’s efforts to bolster Manila’s asymmetric capabilities in the South China Sea and Luzon Strait. On Nov. 4, two Maritime Tactical Systems T38 Devil Ray USVs were transferred to the Philippine Marine Corps at Subic Bay. “Today marks another meaningful step in our continuing effort to strengthen the capabilities of the Philippine Marine Corps, particularly in the field of archipelagic coastal defense,” said PMC Deputy Commandant Brig. Gen. Bayani Curaming at the ceremony, according to a transcript provided to USNI News. The Philippine Marine Corps was slated as the next force to receive drones after the Philippine Navy, USNI News reported in June . Manila’s Marines are at the forefront of South China Sea disputes, manning outposts surrounded by swarms of Chinese regular and paramilitary forces. An American defense official familiar with the matter also highlighted the possibility of the Philippine Army receiving drones through the program. The force is looking to expand its capabilities to monitor and hold targets under threat in its Archipelagic Coastal Defense plan, USNI News understands. In recent years, Philippine Marines have been equipped with BrahMos coastal defense cruise missiles and were relocated to strategic sealines of communication from the Sulu Sea to the Luzon Strait. Charlie Brown, the Director of the Yokosuka Council on Asia Pacific Studies’ Southeast Asia Regional Program, told USNI News that the drone transfer enables the Marines in maintaining awareness “across a large and increasingly contested maritime domain.” “This is an important element of building a credible archipelagic defense capability: not necessarily matching an adversary platform for platform, but using technology, information-sharing and distributed capabilities to make the Philippines’ maritime approaches more transparent and its territorial defense more resilient,” said Brown. These drones are under a broader effort from the Pentagon to enhance Philippine maritime domain awareness following a renewed series of tensions over disputed territories in the South China Sea between Manila and Beijing. Since 2023, Chinese and Philippine forces have repeatedly clashed across several shoals and reefs claimed by the other. Manila’s nascent modernization efforts to contend with Chinese forces has seen increased American and Japanese backing . Florida-based sea drone manufacturer Maritime Tactical Systems, Inc. was tapped early on to provide the Philippine Navy’s first USVs. Currently, the core of the sea service’s USV Unit One is composed of one T38 Devil Ray and four MANTIS T12s. The Marine Corps USVs were transferred at MARTAC’s new Subic Bay facility. According to a company release, the drone center of excellence is designed to train Philippine drone operators and stock parts for the Devil Rays. “The CoE will also enable creation of local jobs and partnerships to build Philippines capabilities for deploying a large USV fleet over the next several years,” reads the MARTAC release. Over the summer, Mississippi-based Autonomous USV firm Ocean Aero, Inc. delivered four Triton drones to the Philippine Navy. The U.S.-Philippine initiative is currently focused on delivering maritime domain awareness capabilities to address significant gaps around the Southeast Asian archipelago of more than 7,600 islands. However, the program plans to integrate one-way attack drones and other lethal capabilities by 2027.

title: Japan to propose Asian version of IEA at AZEC summit
zh_title: 日本将在AZEC峰会上提议亚洲版IEA
summary: 日本将在 AZEC 峰会上提议亚洲版 IEA - 日本时报 日本将在 AZEC 峰会上提议亚洲版 IEA 日本首相高市早苗计划在建立亚洲版国际能源署 (IEA) 方面发挥作用，以帮助成员国分享石油储备方面的专业知识。 | POOL / VIA BLOOMBERG X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads 电子邮件 打印 书签故事 复制链接 知情人士称，日本首相高市早苗计划在即将举行的马尼拉区域峰会上提议建立亚洲版的国际能源机构（IEA）
content:
日本将在AZEC峰会上提议亚洲版IEA - 日本时报
日本将在AZEC峰会上提议亚洲版IEA
日本首相高市早苗计划在建立亚洲版国际能源署（IEA）方面发挥作用，以帮助成员国分享石油储备方面的专业知识。 |泳池/通过彭博社
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads 电子邮件 打印 书签故事 复制链接
知情人士周日称，日本首相高市早苗计划在即将于马尼拉举行的区域峰会上提议建立亚洲版的国际能源署（IEA）。
通过设想的框架，日本旨在加强石油储备方面的合作，以应对能源危机，该框架的目的是加强亚洲能源供应链，该供应链的脆弱性在中东持续动荡后已暴露无遗。
消息人士称，高市将于周二在由 11 个成员国组成的亚洲零排放共同体 (AZEC) 峰会上介绍该计划，该共同体是一个实现碳中和的区域合作框架。
日本将在建立亚洲版IEA中发挥作用，而总部位于雅加达的东盟和东亚经济研究所（ERIA）将作为新框架的秘书处，该研究所负责调查和研究该地区的能源安全问题。
新的区域框架将与总部位于巴黎的国际能源署在东京设立的新基地合作，帮助成员国分享石油储存方面的专业知识，并制定紧急情况下释放和共享石油储备的规则。
IEA成立于1974年，第一次石油危机后，要求成员国储存相当于90天消耗量的石油。
为应对中东紧张局势，今年3月及以后IEA成员国联合大规模释放石油储备。但没有任何东盟成员国参与这一协调一致的倡议。
4月份，依赖东盟国家供应外科手套等石油产品的日本宣布启动亚洲广泛能源和资源弹性伙伴关系（Powerr Asia），旨在帮助该地区的供应链保持弹性。
在AZEC峰会的其他地方，预计高一将提议使用日本闲置的储油罐。具体来说，日本将考虑与菲律宾主导的一项倡议合作，建立东南亚联合石油储备系统，并建立允许该地区国家在紧急情况下优先购买石油的机制。
除日本和菲律宾外，AZEC成员有澳大利亚、文莱、柬埔寨、印度尼西亚、老挝、马来西亚、新加坡、泰国和越南。

Japan to propose Asian version of IEA at AZEC summit - The Japan Times
Japan to propose Asian version of IEA at AZEC summit
Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi plans to play a role in establishing an Asian version of the International Energy Agency (IEA) to help member nations share expertise on oil stockpiling. | POOL / VIA BLOOMBERG
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads Email Print Bookmark story Copy link
Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi plans to propose at an upcoming regional summit in Manila the creation of an Asian version of the International Energy Agency (IEA), informed sources said Sunday.
Through the envisioned framework, which would call for cooperation in oil stockpiling in preparation for energy crises, Japan aims to strengthen Asia’s energy supply chains, whose vulnerability has been exposed in the wake of the ongoing Middle East turmoil.
Takaichi will present the plan at a summit Tuesday of the 11-member Asia Zero Emission Community (AZEC), a regional cooperation framework for realizing carbon neutrality, the sources said.
Japan will play a role in establishing the Asian version of the IEA while the Jakarta-based Economic Research Institute for ASEAN and East Asia, or ERIA, which investigates and researches energy security issues in the region, will serve as the secretariat for the new framework.
Working with the Paris-based IEA’s new base to be set up in Tokyo, the new regional framework will help member nations share expertise on oil stockpiling and make rules on the release and sharing of oil reserves in the event of an emergency.
The IEA, established in 1974, after the first oil crisis, requires member countries to stockpile oil equivalent to 90 days of consumption.
In response to the Middle East tensions, IEA member countries jointly released oil reserves on a large scale in and after March this year. But no ASEAN member nations participated in the concerted initiative.
In April, Japan, which relies on ASEAN countries for the supply of oil-based products such as surgical gloves, announced the launch of the Partnership on Wide Energy and Resources Resilience Asia, or Powerr Asia, which is designed to help make the region’s supply chains resilient.
Elsewhere at the AZEC summit, Takaichi is expected to propose the use of idled oil storage tanks in Japan. Specifically, Japan will consider cooperating for a Philippines-led initiative to develop a joint oil reserve system for Southeast Asia and establishing a mechanism allowing nations in the region to buy oil on a priority base in the event of an emergency.
The AZEC members other than Japan and the Philippines are Australia, Brunei, Cambodia, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam.

summary: 皇岗新口岸发生防滑事故后将加防滑层中国劳工布告栏 星期日, 15 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 发生打滑事故后，新皇岗口岸将加装防滑材料 周六，两辆车因降雨而滑向墙壁，香港路政署将于本周初在新皇岗口岸公共交通交汇处的额外路段应用防滑材料。该部门表示，该地区最初并未纳入治疗范围。路政署将采取防滑措施
content:
皇岗新口岸发生防滑事故后将加防滑层中国劳工公告栏
星期日, 15 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻（英文）
皇岗新口岸发生防滑事故后将加设防滑层
周六，两辆车因降雨而滑向墙壁，香港路政署将于本周初在新皇岗口岸公共交通交汇处的额外路段应用防滑材料。该部门表示，该地区最初并未纳入治疗范围。
路政署将于本周初对皇岗新口岸公共交通交汇处的其他路段进行防滑铺装，预计工程将于近期完成。
这一决定是在网上视频显示周六发生的两起不同的交通事故后作出的，其中一辆出租车和一辆长途客车在降雨后在湿滑的道路上滑向墙壁。
海关回应查询时澄清，两宗意外均发生在皇岗新联检大楼二楼过境巴士落客区。
该部门补充说，这个位于巴士停车位正对面的特定区域最初并不包括在指定防滑材料区域的范围内。
事件发生前，所有跨境巴士停车位及附近出入口急弯处均已铺设防滑材料。

Anti-skid surfacing to be added at new Huanggang Port after skid accidents | China Labour Bulletin Board
Sunday, 15 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Anti-skid surfacing to be added at new Huanggang Port after skid accidents
Hong Kong's Highways Department will apply anti-skid materials to extra sections of the public transport interchange at the new Huanggang Port early this week after two vehicles skidded into a wall on Saturday following rainfall. The department said the area was not initially included for treatment.
The Highways Department will apply anti-skid surfacing to additional sections of the public transport interchange at the new Huanggang Port early this week, with works expected to be completed shortly.
The decision follows online videos showing two separate traffic accidents on Saturday, in which a taxi and a coach skidded into a wall on the slippery road after rainfall.
In response to inquiries, the department clarified that the two accidents occurred at the cross-boundary bus drop-off area on the second floor of the new Huanggang Joint Inspection Building.
This specific section, which is located directly opposite the bus parking spaces, was not initially included in the scope of areas designated for anti-skid materials, the department added.
Prior to the incidents, anti-skid materials had already been applied to all cross-boundary bus parking spaces and nearby sharp bends at the entry and exit points.

title: U.S. Navy Expands Tomahawk Warhead Production Capacity at China Lake
zh_title: 美国海军扩大中国湖战斧弹头生产能力
summary: 中国湖新落成的 300 加仑能量混合器预计到 2027 年 6 月达到生产能力，与行业合作伙伴一起为 WDU-36/B 战斧弹头建立另一个美国海军运营的来源。 NAWCWD 新闻稿 一年前，海军空战中心武器部门的能量学团队从博物馆中取出了一个战斧弹头盒。该团队将炸药和火箭推进剂混合在一起，并将其装入海军武器中。他们清理了箱子。他们将PBXN-107炸药混合并填充到WDU-36/B弹头中。测试、成像和 X 射线证实团队正确填充了它
content:
中国湖新落成的 300 加仑能量混合器预计到 2027 年 6 月达到生产能力，与行业合作伙伴一起为 WDU-36/B 战斧弹头建立另一个美国海军运营的来源。 NAWCWD 新闻稿 一年前，海军空战中心武器部门的能量学团队从博物馆中取出了一个战斧弹头盒。该团队将炸药和火箭推进剂混合在一起，并将其装入海军武器中。他们清理了箱子。他们将PBXN-107炸药混合并填充到WDU-36/B弹头中。测试、成像和 X 射线证实团队正确填充了它。今年秋天，同一个团队填充了七颗首枚战斧弹头，这是新生产商建造的第一批用于检查的装置。能量处理部门负责人赞恩·戈德特表示，一旦通过，它们将成为“中国湖”的第一批生产弹头。这些子弹是由一台 150 加仑的 China Lake 搅拌机生产的，该搅拌机已经运行了数十年。 11 月 9 日，NAWCWD 在重建的汽车装配厂内为一台新的 300 加仑搅拌机剪彩。一旦在 2027 年 6 月左右上线，混合器将使团队达到生产率。目标是在雷神公司需要弹头之前准备好弹头，帮助确保战斧式弹头持续、准时地交付给舰队。 NAWCWD 战斧技术项目办公室主任帕特里夏·霍托（Patricia Hottowe）表示，“战斧”可以让舰艇和潜艇从安全水域、远离敌人射程的地方开火。
霍托维说：“为同等或接近同等的对手储备足够的武器对国家国防至关重要。”8月份，海军授予雷神公司一份价值229亿美元的合同，以加速战斧生产。推进和能量部门负责人瑞安·亨特表示，更快的生产需要更大的弹头容量。中国湖的海军实验室和马里兰州海军水面作战中心印度司令部表示他们可以完成这项工作。但关键零件和材料可能需要长达一年的时间才能到达。在演示构建过程中，团队还发现弹头规格需要进行重大更新。 Hottowe 表示，该团队在过去一年中花了很多时间更新规范和批准的供应商名单。海军弹头技术主管部门必须批准每个新供应商。每个未来的生产商，无论是海军还是工业界，都必须按照该规范进行生产。 NAWCWD 还在签订多年合同之前购买了长周期材料。这样可以更快地提供材料。霍托维表示，该团队在日常工作的同时承担了这项工作，到目前为止几乎没有增加人员。这种情况正在改变。十多名新员工正在加入该团队。戈德特表示，他们将在经验丰富的技术人员的指导下接受大约一年的安全、质量和程序培训，然后再自行工作。戈德特说，装载弹头是最简单的部分。购买材料、招募人员和获得答案都更加困难。亨特表示，挑战来自于为固定的多年时间表而构建的系统。
现在，该系统必须在更短的时钟下运行得更快。NAWCWD 执行董事丹·卡雷尼奥 (Dan Carreño) 经常用一句话来总结这个问题：“武器需要太长时间，成本太高，而且到达目的地后就无关紧要了。”化学反应取决于数十年的实践。自 20 世纪 90 年代中期以来，该部门一直为海军空射导弹 SLAM-ER 填充弹头。戈德特说，他的团队经常在短时间内制作出独一无二的原型。这段经历让团队在“战斧”上行动得更快。雷神公司作为主承包商建造战斧。通用动力军械和战术系统机器 t

【原文 English Original】
A newly inaugurated 300-gallon energetics mixer at China Lake is slated to reach production rate by June 2027, establishing an additional U.S. Navy-run source for WDU-36/B Tomahawk warheads alongside industry partners. NAWCWD press release A year ago, the energetics team at Naval Air Warfare Center Weapons Division pulled a Tomahawk warhead case out of a museum. The team mixes explosives and rocket propellants and loads them into Navy weapons. They cleaned the case. They mixed PBXN-107 explosive and filled the WDU-36/B warhead. Testing, imaging and X-rays confirmed the team filled it correctly. This fall, the same team filled seven first-article Tomahawk warheads, the first units a new producer builds for inspection. Once they pass, they become China Lake’s first production warheads, said Zane Goedert, head of the Energetics Processing Branch. Those rounds came off a 150-gallon mixer China Lake has run for decades. On Nov. 9, NAWCWD cut the ribbon on a new 300-gallon mixer in the rebuilt Motor Assembly Compound. Once online around June 2027, the mixer will let the team reach production rate. The goal is warheads ready before Raytheon needs them, helping ensure continuous, on-time Tomahawk deliveries to the fleet. Patricia Hottowe, director of the Tomahawk Technical Project Office at NAWCWD, said Tomahawk lets ships and submarines fire from safe waters, out of an enemy’s range. “Having an adequate stockpile of those for a peer or near-peer adversary is critical to the nation’s defense,” Hottowe said. In August, the Navy awarded Raytheon a $22.9 billion contract to accelerate Tomahawk production. Faster production calls for more warhead capacity, said Ryan Hunter, head of the Propulsion and Energetics Division. Navy labs at China Lake and at Naval Surface Warfare Center Indian Head Division in Maryland said they could do the work. But key parts and materials can take up to a year to arrive. During the demonstration build, the team also found the warhead specification needed a major update. Hottowe said the team spent much of the past year updating the specification and the approved supplier list. The Navy’s technical authority for the warhead must approve each new supplier. Every future producer, Navy or industry, must build to that specification. NAWCWD also bought long-lead materials ahead of the multiyear contract. That puts material on hand sooner. Hottowe said the team took on the work alongside its day jobs, with little added staff so far. That is changing. More than a dozen new hires are joining the team. Goedert said they will train under experienced technicians on safety, quality and procedures for about a year before working on their own. Goedert said loading the warhead is the easiest part. Buying materials, bringing on people and getting answers are harder. Hunter said the challenge comes from a system built for fixed multiyear schedules. Now that system must move faster on a shorter clock. NAWCWD Executive Director Dan Carreño often sums up the problem in one line: “Weapons take too long, cost too much, and are irrelevant when they get there.” The chemistry rests on decades of practice. The branch has filled warheads for SLAM-ER, a Navy air-launched missile, since the mid-1990s. Goedert said his team routinely turns one-of-a-kind prototypes around on short timelines. That experience let the team move faster on Tomahawk. Raytheon builds Tomahawk as the prime contractor. General Dynamics Ordnance and Tactical Systems machines the warhead cases. L3Harris loads them with explosive today. Guests gather in the large mix bay to watch a demonstration of a new 300-gallon mixer after its ribbon cutting at the China Lake Propulsion Laboratory, Nov. 9, 2026. Once online around June 2027, the mixer will let Naval Air Warfare Center Weapons Division’s energetics team reach production rate on Tomahawk warheads for the fleet. (U.S. Navy photo by Michael L. Smith) Rear Adm. Eric Gardner, principal deputy for the Portfolio Acquisition Executive Munitions, spoke at the ribbon cutting. He said the first-article warheads lay the groundwork for China Lake to become an additional source of Tomahawk warhead production. “At PAE Munitions, we know that increasing weapons production takes more than contracts and funding,” Gardner said. “It takes people, infrastructure, materials, and strong partnerships across our Navy, our warfare centers and industry.” In September, L3Harris and NAWCWD signed a multiyear public-private partnership to manufacture missile components. Under it, Hunter said, NAWCWD plans to produce a portion of the Tomahawk warheads. Carreño called China Lake’s energetics operation a pilot plant that will keep doing developmental testing. When industry needs NAWCWD, he said, the command now has “the legs and the horsepower to go augment.” Inside NAWCWD, the warhead effort tied the Tomahawk Technical Project Office tightly to the energetics team. Hunter said he has never seen a closer partnership in his career. China Lake’s plant layout adds speed. “Because our plant is dispersed and because we will be curing the warheads in a different area than we’re casting them, we’re able to do simultaneous processes that will get higher throughput,” Hunter said. The plant’s newest buildings grew out of a rebuild. The July 2019 earthquakes destroyed three energetics compounds in the Salt Wells area of the China Lake Propulsion Laboratory. Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command broke ground on their replacements, known as the trio, in April 2022. The Nov. 9 ceremony celebrated the trio. Goedert said the team designed the Motor Assembly Compound to cut handling. Large rocket motors risk damage each time crews move them after casting. The same layout will speed warhead work. The new mixer, built by B&P Littleford, works much like a kitchen stand mixer, Goedert said. It is built for thick propellants and explosives. The mixer’s bowl will weigh close to 20,000 pounds. Today, crews mix in one building and cast in another, about half a mile away. In the compound’s large mix bay, the bowl will move across the room into a lift. An hourlong move will drop to 15 minutes. Those minutes count. Once mixed, these explosives start to set. Depending on the mix, crews have a couple of hours to eight or nine hours to cast it. The new layout will give back about 45 minutes of that window. Even the lift is a China Lake design. Before the team had one, workers hoisted the 150-gallon mixer’s 4,000-pound bowl and worked beneath the suspended load. Eric Wooding, a mechanical engineer, helped design a lift for that bowl years ago. “It was an idea of some people here and nobody would bid it. So we just decided to do it ourselves,” Wooding said. China Lake’s machine shop built the frame and parts. The lift worked from the start and has stayed in regular service since 2020. When the 300-gallon mixer went in, the team told the vendor to base the larger lift’s design on that concept. Hunter said the team is ready to “stand in the gap” when the Navy calls. “When we successfully complete this warhead production and ultimately return it to industry, where production belongs,” Hunter said, “we’ll be ready to take on the next challenge.” The post U.S. Navy Expands Tomahawk Warhead Production Capacity at China Lake appeared first on Naval News .

summary: AIT 与 TECRO 通过新台湾奖学金计划加强美台伙伴关系 PR-2631 2026 年 11 月 11 日 AIT 与 TECRO 通过新台湾奖学金计划加强美台伙伴关系 2026 年 11 月 10 日，美国在台协会 (AIT) 华盛顿常务董事 Ingrid Larson 与台北驻美国经济文化代表处 (TECRO) 代表 Alexander Tah-Ray Yui 签署了一份建立台湾奖学金计划（TFP）的谅解备忘录（MOU）。 《台湾联谊法》获得国会通过并签署成为法律
content:
AIT 和 TECRO 通过新的台湾奖学金计划加强美国与台湾的伙伴关系 PR-2631 2026 年 11 月 11 日 AIT 和 TECRO 通过新的台湾奖学金计划加强美国与台湾的伙伴关系 2026 年 11 月 10 日，美国在台协会 (AIT) 华盛顿董事总经理 Ingrid Larson 和台北驻美国经济文化代表处 (TECRO) 代表 Alexander Tah-Ray Yui 签署了一份建立台湾奖学金计划（TFP）的谅解备忘录（MOU）。 《台湾奖学金法案》在两党广泛支持下获得国会通过并签署成为法律。今天，AIT 和 TECRO 签署了谅解备忘录，并与国务院教育和文化事务局协调，启动了该计划的实施。该计划的主要目标是扩大和加强美台伙伴关系，并加强美国官员在台湾和海峡两岸问题上的专业知识。 TFP 将在台湾各地建立一批具有语言技能、文化知识和持久工作关系的联邦专业人士。根据该奖学金计划，美国联邦雇员将花费长达一年的时间进行强化普通话培训和地区研究。培训完成后，研究员预计将在台湾议会办公室、部委、其他机构或办公室或台湾公共部门以外的组织工作最长一年。
国会议员以及美国国务院、TECRO 和 AIT 的代表出席了在弗吉尼亚州阿灵顿举行的签字仪式，与会者称赞该计划在加强美台伙伴关系和建立美国政府在台湾问题上的专业知识方面所发挥的作用。美国在台协会董事总经理英格丽·拉尔森 (Ingrid Larson) 表示：“TFP 反映了两党对美台关系的大力支持以及对以民间关系为核心的共同承诺。” 《AIT 和 TECRO 通过新台湾奖学金计划加强美台伙伴关系》一文首先发表在美国在台协会上。

【原文 English Original】
AIT and TECRO Strengthen U.S.-Taiwan Partnership Through New Taiwan Fellowship Program PR-2631 November 11, 2026 AIT and TECRO Strengthen U.S.-Taiwan Partnership Through New Taiwan Fellowship Program   On November 10, 2026, American Institute in Taiwan (AIT) Washington Managing Director Ingrid Larson and the Taipei Economic and Cultural Representative Office in the United States (TECRO) Representative Alexander Tah-Ray Yui signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) to establish the Taiwan Fellowship Program (TFP).   The Taiwan Fellowship Act was passed by Congress and signed into law with broad bipartisan support. Today’s signing of the MOU between AIT and TECRO initiates the program’s implementation, in coordination with the Department of State’s Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs. The main objectives of the Program are to expand and strengthen the U.S.-Taiwan partnership, as well as strengthen U.S. officials’ expertise regarding Taiwan and cross-Strait issues. TFP will build a group of federal professionals with language skills, cultural knowledge, and lasting working relationships across Taiwan.   Under the fellowship program, U.S. federal employees will spend up to one year in intensive Mandarin language training and area studies. Upon completion of training, the Fellows are expected to work, for up to one year, in Taiwan parliamentary offices, ministries, other agencies or offices, or organizations outside the public sector in Taiwan.   Members of Congress and representatives from the U.S. Department of State, TECRO, and AIT attended the signing ceremony in Arlington, Virginia, where attendees praised the program’s role in strengthening the U.S.-Taiwan partnership and building U.S. government expertise on Taiwan.   “TFP reflects strong bipartisan support for the U.S.-Taiwan relationship and a shared commitment to the people-to-people ties at its core,” said AIT Managing Director Ingrid Larson. title: Taiwan Indigenous farmer revives climate-resilient millet
zh_title: 台湾本土农民复兴气候适应型小米
summary: Indigenous farmer Banu Ismahasan walks through a golden field of tall stalks in southeastern Taiwan , harvesting by hand the grain heads of an ancient crop resistant to extreme weather. Taiwan farmer Banu Ismahasan spreads freshly harvested oil millet out to dry in the sun in Taitung on October 21, 2026. Photo: I-Hwa Cheng / AFP Once grown by Indigenous farmers in Taiwan in case their staple crops died, oil millet largely disappeared from fields more than 60 years ago as rice became more available.在过去的十年里，伊斯玛哈桑和他年迈的父母一直致力于复兴几乎被遗忘的地方。
content:
台湾东南部的原住民农民巴努·伊斯马哈桑 (Banu Ismahasan) 走过一片金色的高秆田，用手收割一种能够抵抗极端天气的古老作物的谷粒。 2026 年 10 月 21 日，台湾农民巴努·伊斯马哈桑 (Banu Ismahasan) 在台东将刚收获的油小米摊开在阳光下晒干。照片：I-Hwa Cheng/AFP 台湾原住民农民曾种植油小米，以防主粮枯死，但 60 多年前，随着水稻变得更加容易获得，油小米基本上从田间消失了。在过去的十年里，伊斯马哈桑和他年迈的父母一直在台东县布克拉武村的布农社区努力恢复几乎被遗忘的农作物。 “我们只是希望带回许多传统的布农族作物，并再次在这片土地上种植它们，”48岁的伊斯马哈桑在晴朗的蓝天下的油小米田里告诉法新社。油小米，即布农语中的“莳萝”，是台湾特有的植物，可以在山上野生生长。伊斯玛哈桑首先在网上了解到这种植物，然后开始自己的研究，梳理历史文献并与部落长老交谈，其中包括一位记得上次吃这种植物是在半个世纪前的妇女。他发现，布农族农民过去常常在种植主要作物谷子的同时种植油小米，作为收成歉收或发生灾害时的“后备”。经过多年亲自种植油小米，伊斯玛哈桑开始明白为什么他的祖先依赖这种作物。
一粒油小米种子可以长出 15 至 20 个圆锥花序或分枝种子簇，并且茎可以自行再生，而谷子通常每粒种子长出一个圆锥花序，必须在切割后重新播种。事实证明，当极端天气或疾病爆发破坏了他 2.2 公顷（5.4 英亩）的农场时，它比谷子更坚强。伊斯马哈桑说，几年前一场持续了 200 多天的干旱期间，油小米“保持鲜绿色”，而其他作物却枯萎了。台风、洪水，甚至锈病爆发也没有影响到它。台湾中央研究院退休教授、植物遗传学专家邢月娥15年前在一个国际论坛上第一次听说了油小米。幸不知道的是，1890 年代采集的台湾油粟标本就存放在英国皇家植物园 (Kew)。兴带领一个研究小组在台湾东南部的山区找到了油小米，并开始研究这种鲜为人知的谷物。她发现，种子的保护性蜡涂层使其无需灌溉、化肥或杀虫剂即可生长，即使在质量较差的土地上也是如此。 2026 年 10 月 21 日，台湾农民 Linkav Ismahasan 在台东的一块田里收割油小米。照片：I-Hwa Cheng / 法新社 油小米富含油、蛋白质和矿物质，可用于人类和动物消费，也可用作燃料。 “它在利用阳光和水方面自然非常有效，”辛说。
“至于土壤条件，即使是在地面布满大石头的山区，它也能生长得很好。” “非常珍贵”伊斯马哈桑从一粒油小米开始了他的种植。现在，这个家庭每年在他们种植其他传统布农谷类作物的土地上每年收获两次油小米。油小米个头小，无味，可以用来做粥、馒头、面包，甚至爆米花。但该家族一直在努力说服其他农民种植这种植物，因为它在商业上尚不可行。油粟不仅是劳动密集型产业，而且意义重大

【原文 English Original】
Indigenous farmer Banu Ismahasan walks through a golden field of tall stalks in southeastern Taiwan , harvesting by hand the grain heads of an ancient crop resistant to extreme weather. Taiwan farmer Banu Ismahasan spreads freshly harvested oil millet out to dry in the sun in Taitung on October 21, 2026. Photo: I-Hwa Cheng / AFP Once grown by Indigenous farmers in Taiwan in case their staple crops died, oil millet largely disappeared from fields more than 60 years ago as rice became more available. Over the past decade, Ismahasan and his elderly parents have worked to revive the nearly forgotten crop in the Bunun community in Buklavu, a village surrounded by lush green mountains in Taitung county. “We just hope to bring back many traditional Bunun crops and grow them on this land again,” Ismahasan, 48, told AFP in his oil millet field under a clear blue sky. Oil millet, or “dill” in the Bunun language, is endemic to Taiwan and can be found growing wild in the mountains. Ismahasan first read about the plant online and then embarked on his own research, combing through historical documents and speaking to tribal elders, including a woman who recalled last eating it half a century ago. He discovered that Bunun farmers used to grow oil millet alongside their staple crop foxtail millet as a “back-up” when harvests failed or disasters hit. After years of growing oil millet himself, Ismahasan came to understand why his ancestors relied on the crop. A single oil millet seed can grow 15 to 20 panicles, or branching seed clusters, and the stems regenerate on their own, while foxtail millet typically grows one panicle per seed and must be sown again after being cut. It has also proven hardier than foxtail millet when extreme weather or disease outbreaks have ravaged his 2.2-hectare (5.4-acre) farm. During a drought several years ago that lasted more than 200 days, the oil millet “stayed bright green” while other crops withered, Ismahasan said. Typhoons, floods and even a rust disease outbreak have not affected it either. Hsing Yue-ie, a retired professor from Taiwan’s Academia Sinica and an expert in plant genetics, first heard of oil millet 15 years ago at an international forum. Unbeknownst to Hsing, specimens of Taiwan oil millet collected in the 1890s were sitting in Britain’s Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew. Hsing led a research team to find oil millet in the mountains of southeastern Taiwan and began studying the little-known cereal. She found that the seed’s protective wax coating enabled it to grow without irrigation, fertilisers or pesticides, even on poor-quality land. Taiwan farmer Linkav Ismahasan harvests oil millet in a field in Taitung on October 21, 2026. Photo: I-Hwa Cheng / AFP Rich in oil, protein and minerals, it can be used for human and animal consumption, as well as for fuel. “It’s naturally very efficient at using sunlight and water,” said Hsing. “As for soil conditions, even in mountainous areas where the ground is full of large rocks, it can still grow very well.” ‘Very precious’ Ismahasan started his crop with one panicle of oil millet. The family now harvests oil millet twice a year on a section of their property where they grow other traditional Bunun cereal crops. Tiny and tasteless, oil millet can be used in porridge, steamed buns, bread and even popcorn. But the family has struggled to convince other farmers to grow it because it is not yet commercially viable. Oil millet is not only labour intensive but also significantly more expensive for consumers than rice, by far Taiwan’s most popular staple. While the current market for oil millet is limited, Taiwan’s National Crop Germplasm Center sees value in preserving its seeds for the future, when climate change might force more farmers to consider growing the crop. Oil millet seeds are “very precious” because of their genetic diversity and ability to adapt to the environment, Lin Yen-yu, an assistant researcher at the centre, told AFP. Seeds are kept in aluminium foil packets and stored at -18C under low-moisture conditions where they can last for decades, Lin said. “In the future, when cultivation methods or climate change undergo certain shifts, their value may start to be recognised and discovered,” he said. “It preserves many possibilities.” Ismahasan said his priority for now was to get more people in his community growing and eating oil millet, bringing “it back into our everyday lives, just as it was for our elders”. “If we don’t even eat it ourselves anymore, how can we expect to turn it into a viable business?” he said.

title: Hong Kong lawmakers pass bill to streamline Northern Metropolis development
zh_title: 香港立法会通过法案简化北方都市发展
summary: 香港立法者已通过一项法案，以简化耗资数十亿美元的北方都市计划，一名官员表示，当局计划在明年第一季度实施便利措施。这张照片显示了将成为香港北部都会区的地区，背景是深圳的天际线。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。立法会周四三读通过了《北方都市发展法案》，这是一项专门立法，旨在简化规划和土地程序，并加快建设和工业运营。
content:
香港立法者已通过一项法案，以简化耗资数十亿美元的北方都市计划，一名官员表示，当局计划在明年第一季度实施便利措施。这张照片显示了将成为香港北部都会区的地区，背景是深圳的天际线。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。立法会周四通过了《北方都市发展法案》的三读，该法案旨在简化规划和土地程序，并加快这一庞大项目的建设和工业运营。该立法还将促进资本、货物和人员的跨境流动，因为当局寻求通过这个大型项目加深香港与中国大陆的融合。一旦颁布，非保护区重新划定开发的审批期将从九个月缩短至两个月，同时征地和城市规划程序也将得到简化。发展主管伯纳黛特·林恩(Bernadette Linn)周四表示，当局计划在一月份向立法会提交附属立法，并在第一季度推出具体措施。 “现阶段，我们并不寻求一项能够解决所有可能情况的包罗万象的立法，”林恩用粤语告诉立法会议员。
“随着北方都市发展的进展，将出台新的立法，并根据需要修改现有条例。”发展局局长 Bernadette Linn。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。这个大型项目于 2021 年宣布，计划将约 300 平方公里（约占香港面积的三分之一）改造成香港与深圳边境沿线的创新和技术中心。另请参阅：科技城到大学城：为什么香港北部大都会将重点从高科技转向高等教育周三，当局和香港铁路运营商港铁公司宣布，一条连接北部大都会与香港现有地铁网络的新线路将耗资约 862 亿港元，比最初的估计下降了四分之一以上。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong lawmakers have passed a bill to streamline the multi-billion-dollar Northern Metropolis plan, with an official saying that authorities aim to implement facilitatory measures in the first quarter of next year. This photo shows the area that will become Hong Kong’s Northern Metropolis, with Shenzhen’s skyline in the background. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The Legislative Council (LegCo) on Thursday passed the third reading of the Northern Metropolis Development Bill, dedicated legislation that would streamline planning and land procedures and expedite construction and industrial operations in the sprawling project. The legislation would also facilitate the cross-boundary flow of capital, goods and people, as authorities seek to deepen Hong Kong’s integration with mainland China through the mega-project. Once enacted, the approval period for rezoning non-conservation areas for development could be cut from nine months to two, while land resumption and urban planning procedures would be simplified. Development chief Bernadette Linn said on Thursday that authorities were aiming to table subsidiary legislation to LegCo in January and roll out concrete measures in the first quarter. “At this stage we do not seek an all-encompassing piece of legislation capable of addressing every possible scenario,” Linn told lawmakers in Cantonese. “As the Northern Metropolis development progresses, new legislation will be introduced and existing ordinances will be amended as necessary.” Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The mega-project, announced in 2021, is set to transform about 300 square kilometres – roughly a third of the city’s territory – into an innovation and technology hub alongside Hong Kong’s border with Shenzhen. See also: Technopole to University Towns: Why Hong Kong’s Northern Metropolis shifted focus from hi-tech to higher ed On Wednesday, authorities and the MTR Corporation, Hong Kong’s railway operator, announced that a new line linking the Northern Metropolis with the city’s existing metro network would cost about HK$86.2 billion – down more than a quarter from original estimates.

content:
出于安全考虑，无人机所有权禁令在北京生效 - 日本时报
出于安全考虑，北京实施无人机所有权禁令
10月26日，一面中国国旗在北京中央商务区的摩天大楼前飘扬。路透社
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads 电子邮件 打印 书签故事 复制链接
北京——北京禁止拥有无人机的禁令于周日生效，当局称这项措施将有助于确保中国首都的安全。
该禁令适用于该市面积约 16,400 平方公里（大约是比利时面积一半）的城市化和农村地区。
北京于九月宣布的这项禁令禁止拥有和储存无人驾驶飞行器（UAV），以“维护首都安全”。
还禁止将无人机或其组件运输到城市。
在周日实施之前，业主被迫扔掉他们的设备，要么在批准的回购点或在网上转售。
他们也可以将他们运送到执法区域之外。
北京是中国中央政府、最高领导人和执政的中国共产党总部的所在地，面临着严格的安全措施。
6 月份，一架小型飞机撞向该市最高的摩天大楼，造成飞行员死亡、另有 13 人受伤，引发了空域安全担忧，随后出台了这项禁令。
北京已于 2026 年 5 月禁止无人机销售，业主被要求向当局注册其设备，但可以保留它们。
现在，任何拥有无人机的人都可能面临罚款并没收其设备。
出于反恐、执法、紧急救援、农业或科学研究等特定原因，可能会给予无人机飞行豁免。
近年来，无人机在中国变得非常流行，特别是在拍摄风景方面。

Drone ownership ban comes into force in Beijing over security concerns
A Chinese national flag flies in front of skyscrapers of Beijing's Central Business District on Oct. 26. | REUTERS
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads Email Print Bookmark story Copy link
Beijing – Beijing’s ban on possessing drones came into force Sunday, a measure authorities said will help ensure the security of China’s capital city.
The ban applies to both urbanized and rural areas in the municipality of around 16,400 square kilometers — an area roughly half the size of Belgium.
The ban, which Beijing announced in September, outlaws owning and storing uncrewed aerial vehicles (UAVs) to “safeguard the security of the capital.”
Transporting drones or their components into the city was also forbidden.
Owners had been forced to get rid of their devices ahead of Sunday’s implementation, either by reselling them at approved buy-back points or online.
They could also have transported them outside the enforcement area.
Beijing, home to China’s central government, top leaders and the headquarters of the ruling Chinese Communist Party (CCP), has faced strict security measures.
The ban comes after airspace safety fears were raised in June when a small plane crashed into the city’s tallest skyscraper, killing the pilot and injuring 13 others.
Beijing had already banned drone sales in May 2026, with owners required to register their devices with authorities but permitted to keep them.
Now, anyone in possession of a drone could face a fine and the confiscation of their equipment.
Exemptions for drone flights may be granted for specific reasons such as counterterrorism, law enforcement, emergency relief, agriculture or scientific research.
Drones have become extremely popular in China in recent years, particularly for filming landscapes.

summary: 在海军潜艇联盟 2026 年年度研讨会上的一系列演讲中，美国太平洋舰队潜艇部队司令克里斯·卡瓦诺 (Chris Cavanaugh) 就太平洋地区对手的发展和活动状况发表了讲话，强调了美国海军潜艇舰队面临的关键威胁。中国海军潜艇新型09IIIB型核潜艇，在中国社交媒体上分享的编辑图像。在考虑对美国海军的挑战时，RADM 卡瓦诺重申了中华人民共和国中国人民解放军海军（PLAN）作为印度-太平洋地区最大威胁的地位
content:
在海军潜艇联盟 2026 年年度研讨会上的一系列演讲中，美国太平洋舰队潜艇部队司令克里斯·卡瓦诺 (Chris Cavanaugh) 就太平洋地区对手的发展和活动状况发表了讲话，强调了美国海军潜艇舰队面临的关键威胁。中国海军潜艇新型09IIIB型核潜艇，在中国社交媒体上分享的编辑图像。 RADM 卡瓦诺在考虑对美国海底主导地位的挑战时重申了中华人民共和国中国人民解放军海军（PLAN）作为印度-太平洋地区最大威胁的地位，代表着对抗美国海军的最具创新性的力量之一。然而，在这起事件中，卡瓦诺号更加阐明了中国被视为海底领域主要对手的理由。中国威胁图景的很大一部分源于中国海军将船体下水的速度，8艘093B型（Shang III）型核快速攻击潜艇（SSN）在不到4年的时间里投入使用。 RADM Cavanaugh 还相信美国对中国 SSN 生产的评估，该评估规定中国海军造船厂可以维持类似的生产率至少十年，20-40 艘商 III 或改进型 SSN 可能会在这段时间内投入使用。
卡瓦诺进一步表示，“尚III”级潜艇比以前的中国核潜艇具有重大的质的改进，具有先进的静音技术、24个垂直发射单元库以及推进方法的重大变化。这些改进产生了质的飞跃，以至于“商III”级潜艇可以被认为是一种全新级别的潜艇。 “这表明中国已经准备好进行迭代。他们建造了商，他们建造了商 III，然后他们正在开发下一个产品。我认为迭代本身就有其自身的品质。” ——克里斯·卡瓦诺少将，美国太平洋舰队潜艇部队司令。关于进一步的发展，美国潜艇部队密切关注中国未来的095型核导导弹潜艇的进展，指出其增加的X型舵和泵喷推进装置并不是完全颠覆，而是表明了中国潜艇部队创新和风险吸收的明显趋势。除了095型之外，美国还关注096型和094型弹道导弹核潜艇（SSBN）的发展，这代表着中国核三位一体和二次打击能力的关键发展。也许最关键的是，美国潜艇部队评估了建设和支持日益庞大且质量先进的中国核舰队所需的支持基础设施的持续建设。
卡瓦诺还指出，随着中国在战略和战术层面上不断改进核潜艇的使用，理论方面的改进与配套基础设施和舰队本身的建设相匹配。中国海军研究船东方红3号停靠在青岛。 Cnsphoto 来自路透社。在对解放军潜艇威胁进行评估后，RADM Cavanaugh 进一步强调了解放军为更好地准备其水下部队以应对任何潜在冲突所做的努力，其中海洋学研究、测量和测绘在解放军为应对与美国或其盟国的任何潜在冲突所做的准备中发挥了重要作用。特别是卡瓦

【原文 English Original】
In a series of talks at the Navy Submarine League’s 2026 Annual Symposium, Rear Admiral Chris Cavanaugh (Commander, Submarine Forces, U.S. Pacific Fleet – COMSUBPAC) spoke on the state o f adversary developments and activities in the Pacific, highlighting the critical threats facing the U.S. Navy’s submarine fleet. PLAN Submarines The new Type 09IIIB SSN, edited image shared on Chinese social media. RADM Cavanaugh reaffirmed the People’s Republic of China’s People’s Liberation Army Navy (PLAN) position as the top threat in the Indo-Pacific region when considering challenges to America’s undersea dominance, representing the one of most innovative forces facing down the U.S. Navy. However, in this instance, the Cavanaugh shed greater light on the reasoning behind China’s appraisal as the primary adversary in the undersea domain. A large element of China’s threat picture stems from the sheer rate at which the PLAN is able to put hulls in the water, with 8 Type 093B (Shang III) type Nuclear Fast Attack Submarines (SSNs) entering service in under 4 years. RADM Cavanaugh also gave credence to U.S. assessments regarding Chinese SSN production, which stipulate that a similar rate of production is sustainable by PLAN yards for at least a decade, with 20-40 Shang III or improved SSNs potentially reaching service in that timeframe. Cavanaugh further stated that the Shang III represents a serious qualitative improvement over previous Chinese SSNs, featuring advanced quieting techniques, a Vertical Launch Cell bank of 24 cells, and significant changes to the propulsion method. These improvements produced a qualitative jump to such an extent that the Shang IIIs could be considered an entirely new class of submarine. “It points to the idea that China is ready to iterate. They build Shang, they build Shang III, and they’re onto the next thing. And I would argue that iteration itself has a quality on its own.” – Rear Admiral Chris Cavanaugh, Commander, Submarine Forces, U.S. Pacific Fleet. In regards to further developments, the U.S. sub force closely monitored processes surrounding the Type 095, China’s prospective nuclear guided missile submarine, pointing to its addition of X-form rudders and pump jet propulsion not as complete upsets, but as demonstrative of a tangible trend of innovation and risk absorption by the Chinese submarine force. Alongside the 095, the U.S. also follows the development of the Type 096 and Type 094 classes of nuclear ballistic missile submarines (SSBNs), representing key developments in China’s nuclear triad and second strike capability. Perhaps most critical, the U.S. sub force assessed the continual buildup of supporting infrastructure needed to build out and support an increasingly large and qualitatively advanced Chinese nuclear fleet. Cavanaugh also noted improvements in doctrine match any build outs of supporting infrastructure and the fleet itself, with the Chinese continually improving in their usage of nuclear submarines at a strategic and tactical level. Other PLAN Activities Chinese Research vessel Dong Fang Hong 3 docked in Qingdao. Cnsphoto via REUTERS. Following his assessment of the PLAN submarine threat, RADM Cavanaugh further highlighted PLAN efforts to better prepare its undersea force for any potential conflict, with oceanographic research, surveying, and mapping playing a large part of this component in PLAN preparations for any potential conflict with the United States or its allies. In particular, Cavanaugh confirmed a Reuters report which detailed Chinese undersea research efforts dedicated in part to mapping key operational areas near the Philippines, Taiwan, Guam, and Hawaii, including ingress and egress routes near large submarine bases in the latter two locations. Whilst these mapping efforts and the Chinese-linked vessels conducting them possess valid scientific rationale for their presence under international law, the Navy assesses this research as a vital step in preparing any undersea battlefield. Combined with increased Chinese investments across the board in Unmanned Underwater Vehicles (UUVs), their support ships, and other submersibles, the Navy assesses the Chinese approach to be more holistic in nature, identifying, laying out, and executing key steps in an organized manner to improve the sub-sea force in all aspects. The U.S. Navy assesses that all of these steps, including mapping efforts, expansion of the Chinese submarine industrial base, and continual iteration coalesce into a methodical approach designed to eventually level the playing field in the undersea domain. Russian Efforts Kazan, the first Russian Project 885M Yasen-M-class SSGN, now under operation by Russia’s Pacific Fleet. Russian MOD picture. After the PLAN, Cavanaugh highlighted Russia as the next key adversary facing America under the Pacific’s waves, presenting a somewhat different threat profile. At the top of the list includes Russia’s continual investment into its at-sea strategic deterrent, presenting mostly in the form of newer Project 955 Borei-class (also known as the Yury Dolgorukiy-class) of SSBNs, with both baseline Project 955 and newer Project 955A standard boats under Russian Pacific Fleet operation. “If you saw a graph of undersea defense threats, they’re growing rapidly. I’m talking about SSGNs, SSBNs, with Russia and China combined. And so that has significant implications for our ability to maintain domain awareness with our own force structure.” – Rear Admiral Chris Cavanaugh, Commander, Submarine Forces, U.S. Pacific Fleet. Cavanaugh also briefly highlighted another leg of Russia’s undersea strategic deterrent in the Poseidon nuclear XLUUV (also known as Status-6) as an unconventional threat profile that the U.S. Pacific submarine force would have to grapple with. Amongst the slides, alluded to was the threat presented by Russia’s Yasen or Severodvinsk-class of SSGNs, presenting an extremely quiet class of boats capable of carrying dozens of hypersonic or cruise missiles within close proximity to the U.S.’s coast. Combined with continued and dedicated Russian undersea efforts, Cavanaugh stressed that Russia’s consolidation of newer sea-based nuclear deterrents and continued investments into its submarine fleet still makes it a potent threat, especially when considered in conjunction with the Chinese fleet. Additionally, even as the Russian surface fleet continues to succumb to aging vessels and budget constraints, the Russian sub force will likely remain an important consideration for the threats facing U.S. undersea dominance. Last but Not Least: North Korea Image of the new North Korean SSBN during an inspection conducted by North Korean leader Kim Jong-Un. Image taken from a North Korean State Media Broadcast. North Korea’s threat profile came at the tail end of Cavanaugh’s remarks on the threats facing the U.S. submarine force and sub-sea efforts. Whilst North Korean advancements were of note, in the eyes of the U.S. Navy and its top brass, the substance backing Pyongyang’s claims remains to be seen. Despite this, any potential North Korean advancements list as increasingly consequential, especially considering the domain of at-sea nuclear capabilities. The recently revealed North Korean SSBN as well as suspected claims of advancement in torpedo and propulsion technology depict the main subjects noted in Cavanaugh’s remarks. Whilst the U.S. Navy currently withholds any final judgements on validity of the claims surrounding North Korean improvement, Cavanaugh noted that these developments represent part of an increasingly dense under-sea threat environment coming from three different countries, each with their own intricacies. The post SUBPAC Commander Warns of Rapid Expansion in Chinese and Russian Submarine Fleets appeared first on Naval News .

title: China Lifts The Veil On Its GJ-11 Mysterious Dragon Stealth UCAV
zh_title: 中国揭开GJ-11神秘龙隐形无人机的面纱
summary: 中国为我们提供了迄今为止最清晰的 GJ-11 隐形无人战斗机 (UCAV) 展示，新的官方镜头揭示了这款飞翼无人机以前未见过的细节，包括其内部武器舱、起落架、安装在机头的传感器以及独特的排气装置。与此同时，中国人民解放军空军 (PLAAF) 还声称，GJ-11 已经完成了首次实弹打击任务，取得了成功。这有点令人费解，因为无人战斗机已经进行了多年的测试架次，包括在前方
content:
中国为我们提供了迄今为止最清晰的 GJ-11 隐形无人战斗机 (UCAV) 展示，新的官方镜头揭示了这款飞翼无人机以前未见过的细节，包括其内部武器舱、起落架、安装在机头的传感器以及独特的排气装置。与此同时，中国人民解放军空军 (PLAAF) 还声称，GJ-11 已经完成了首次实弹打击任务，取得了成功。这有点令人费解，因为无人作战飞机多年来已经进行了多次测试，包括在前沿作战地点，而且在此之前几乎无法想象是否进行过实弹武器投送。也许这是在转换过程中丢失某些东西的情况，例如使用新的内部传感器或新型武器发射。跑道上 GJ-11 的正面视图。 PLA screencap 这段视频昨天由中国国家电视台中央电视台播出，距离中国人民解放军空军成立 77 周年还有两天。随附的报告提供了有关该飞机预期任务集的更多详细信息，包括空袭和压制敌方防空系统（SEAD），以及它与有人战斗机的有人与无人编队（MUM-T）行动的整合。
新披露的信息让公众对 GJ-11 的配置有了最全面的了解，并进一步了解中国打算如何使用这款名为“玄龙”的隐形飞翼飞机。GJ-11 起飞。 PLA screencap 仔细观察 GJ-11 最暴露的视图之一显示了 GJ-11 的底面，清楚地暴露了其两个内部武器舱。腹侧舱位于飞机的混合翼体内，具有独立的门组，具有独特的锯齿状边缘——这是低可观察性飞机的常见特征。舱室的内部布局和尺寸仍不清楚，飞机可容纳的武器的精确范围也不清楚。然而，每个舱室似乎可以容纳至少 1,000 磅级武器，甚至可能容纳 2,000 磅级武器。 #GTMilitaryWatch 央视新闻军事频道周一发布了新镜头，以多角度特写镜头展示了中国人民解放军 (PLA) 空军的 GJ-11 隐形无人机。它还透露，空军首批自行训练的两架女无人机… pic.twitter.com/PPVmws9DJJ —《环球时报》（@globaltimesnews）2026年11月9日 据央视报道，这两个舱可携带多种空对地/水面弹药。
此前，中国航空工业集团公司 (AVIC) 在 2021 年中国航展上展示的 GJ-11 模型中曾透露过武器舱配置，但新的镜头可以更好地展示实际飞机。机库中 GJ-11 的正面视图，武器舱门部分打开。 PLA screencap 内部武器架是 GJ-11 隐蔽性设计的核心，使其能够携带弹药，而不会受到与外部挂架和挂具相关的雷达信号（和空气动力学）影响。此前于 2025 年 11 月发布的视频显示，GJ-11 正在飞行，起落架仍处于伸出状态。然而，其中一个新序列显示飞机起飞，随后的侧视图和后视图捕捉到了其起落架在升空后收回的情况。起落架本身非常坚固，包括一个重型起落架

【原文 English Original】
China has provided us with the clearest look yet at its GJ-11 stealth uncrewed combat aerial vehicle (UCAV), with new official footage revealing previously unseen details of the flying-wing drone, including its internal weapons bays, landing gear, nose-mounted sensor installation, and distinctive exhaust arrangement. The release also comes alongside a claim from the People’s Liberation Army Air Force (PLAAF) that the GJ-11 has completed its first live-fire strike mission, scoring a hit. This is somewhat puzzling, since the UCAV has racked up test sorties for years already, including at forward operating locations, and it seems almost inconceivable that a live weapons delivery would not have been conducted before now. Perhaps this is a case of something being lost in translation, such as the use of a new internal sensor or a new type of weapon delivery. Head-on view of a GJ-11 on the runway. PLA screencap The footage, broadcast by Chinese state television’s CCTV yesterday, comes two days ahead of the 77th anniversary of the founding of the PLAAF. Accompanying reporting provides additional details about the aircraft’s intended mission set, including airstrikes and suppression of enemy air defenses (SEAD), as well as its integration into manned-unmanned teaming (MUM-T) operations with crewed fighters. The new disclosures offer the most comprehensive public look yet at the GJ-11’s configuration and provide further insight into how China intends to employ the stealthy flying-wing aircraft, which is named Xuanlong — Chinese for Mystery Dragon. A GJ-11 takes off. PLA screencap A closer look at the GJ-11 One of the most revealing views shows the underside of the GJ-11, clearly exposing its two internal weapons bays. Located within the aircraft’s blended wing-body, the ventral bays have separate sets of doors with distinctive serrated edges — a common feature on low-observable aircraft. The internal arrangement and dimensions of the bays remain unclear, as does the precise range of weapons the aircraft can accommodate. However, it would appear likely that each bay can accommodate at least a 1,000-pound-class and likely a 2,000-pound-class weapon. #GTMilitaryWatch CCTV News military channel released new footage on Monday offering a close-up, multi-angle look at the Chinese People's Liberation Army (PLA) Air Force's GJ-11 stealth drone. It also revealed that two of the Air Force's first batch of self-trained female drone… pic.twitter.com/PPVmws9DJJ — Global Times (@globaltimesnews) November 9, 2026 According to CCTV , the two bays can carry a variety of air-to-ground/surface munitions. The weapons bay configuration had previously been revealed in a model of the GJ-11 displayed by the Aviation Industry Corporation of China (AVIC) at Airshow China in 2021, but the new footage provides a much better look at the actual aircraft. Head-on view of a GJ-11 in the hangar, with the weapons bay doors partially open. PLA screencap Internal weapons carriage is central to the GJ-11’s low-observable design, allowing it to carry munitions without the radar signature (and aerodynamic) penalties associated with external pylons and stores. Previous footage released in November 2025 showed the GJ-11 in flight with its landing gear remaining extended. However, one of the new sequences shows the aircraft taking off, with subsequent side and rear views capturing its landing gear retracting after liftoff. The landing gear itself is notably robust, including a heavy-duty twin-wheel nose unit. With that in mind, it may be the same landing gear as used in the GJ-21, a naval variant capable of operating from aircraft carriers and big-deck assault ships. A GJ-11 retracts its landing gear on takeoff. PLA screencap The new imagery also offers a closer look at a trapezoidal glazed fairing beneath the nose. This appears consistent with an electro-optical/infrared (EO/IR) sensor installation. Its precise configuration and capabilities have not been disclosed, but it’s worth noting that similar-looking installations also appear on the crewed J-20 and J-35 fighters, with these systems apparently being analogous to the electro-optical targeting system, or EOTS, found on the F-35 . If the sensor on the GJ-11 works like an EOTS, it would provide the drone with precision targeting and identification, lasing, as well as a secondary infrared search-and-track emulation function. A view of a GJ-11 showing the undernose EO/IR sensor installation. PLA screencap Perhaps the most distinctive external feature remains the GJ-11’s exhaust arrangement, for what is reported to be a WS-13 turbofan engine. A close-up of the rear of the aircraft shows the flattened exhaust outlet, shielded and integrated into the upper rear portion of the flying-wing airframe. Combined with the dorsal air intake and the absence of conventional exposed engine nozzles, this configuration is intended to reduce the aircraft’s radar and infrared signatures, especially from the most critical view aspects. The GJ-11’s tailless, blended-wing configuration is by now a defining feature of low-observable UCAV designs. Close-up of the tail section of a GJ-11. PLA screencap At least some of the GJ-11s shown have an air data boom on the nose. While normally associated with early flight testing, the GJ-11 is now far beyond that. The booms could still be fitted for some envelope expansion and other flight test work, although it may also simply involve earlier footage. Airstrikes and suppression of enemy air defenses Beyond the new imagery, one of the more interesting aspects of the CCTV coverage is its description of the GJ-11’s intended operational role. The broadcaster identified airstrikes and SEAD among the aircraft’s mission sets. The latter is particularly significant, as penetrating or operating within heavily defended airspace to locate and suppress or destroy enemy air defense systems is the most dangerous mission for a crewed combat aircraft. A stealthy uncrewed aircraft could contribute to these operations by carrying precision-guided weapons into more contested areas, providing additional sensing and targeting capacity, or forcing an adversary to expend valuable air defense resources. The two internal weapons bays provide the means to carry air-to-surface munitions while retaining the aircraft’s low-observable configuration. However, we don’t know which specific weapons have been integrated, their quantities, or whether the GJ-11 can employ dedicated anti-radiation weapons for SEAD missions. Alternative SEAD/DEAD loads could include multiple Small Diameter Bomb (SDB) equivalents, including those that are networked, as we have seen in previous concept videos . Many other types of standoff weapons could also be carried, with the platform itself using onboard sensors for fixing the target or acquiring targeting information from other sources via a tactical data network. Overhead view of a GJ-11 outside the hangar. PLA screencap First live-fire strike claim According to CCTV , the GJ-11 has completed its first live-fire strike mission, with two members of the PLAAF’s initial batch of female drone operators participating in the operation. One of the operators, Shi Xiaoran, described encountering cloud cover that initially obscured the target. After circling once more, she located it and released the weapon, scoring a hit. A drone controller flies a GJ-11 from a command-and-control trailer. PLA screencap One aspect that remains unclear is the extent to which the aircraft can independently identify and engage targets. A successful strike would demonstrate weapons employment, but not necessarily autonomous targeting or engagement. A view of a GJ-11 showing its triangular engine intake and undernose sensor installation. PLA screencap Manned-unmanned teaming with J-16 and J-20 fighters Perhaps the most strategically important aspect of the new coverage is its emphasis on manned-unmanned teaming. The CCTV footage showed mission planning involving a GJ-11 operating alongside J-16 Flanker multirole fighters and, in a separate sequence, J-20 fifth-generation stealth fighters. This provides a more explicit indication of the role China envisions for the GJ-11 within its broader combat aviation ecosystem. The J-16 provides a powerful multirole platform for strike and electronic warfare-related missions , while the J-20 offers a stealthy crewed counterpart for operations in highly contested airspace. An uncrewed aircraft operating alongside either type could extend the formation’s sensor coverage, carry additional weapons, conduct reconnaissance, or undertake particularly hazardous missions. A J-16D electronic warfare aircraft. via Chinese internet As a loyal wingman, the GJ-11’s role would extend beyond simply carrying weapons, with the UCAV able to act as an additional airborne sensor and strike platform, allowing crewed aircraft to distribute tasks across a larger formation. At the same time, the footage does not establish how the UCAVs communicate with their crewed counterparts, how targeting information is shared, or the level of autonomy available to the GJ-11. The new footage shows the drone being flown under man-in-the-loop (MITL) direct control, but it likely features, or will feature, semi-autonomous control modes, especially for teaming applications, which will require a high degree of onboard autonomy. We do know that China expects the UCAV to be controlled by crewed aircraft, as part of its basic concept. The PLAAF has at least trialed crewed aircraft as drone controllers , and this is one mission set that has frequently been ascribed to the two-seat J-20S . A stock photo of the two-seat J-20S. via X From prototype to operational platform After years of development involving the experimental Sharp Sword design , the much more evolved GJ-11 platform was publicly unveiled during China’s National Day military parade in Beijing in October 2019. Its development is associated with Hongdu Aviation Industry Group, part of the broader AVIC aviation-industrial structure. Two views of an early Sharp Sword UCAV demonstrator. via X A model displayed by AVIC at Airshow China in 2021 provided an early indication of the aircraft’s internal weapons-carrying arrangement. In November 2025, as we reported at the time , the PLAAF released footage of the GJ-11 flying alongside a J-20 and a J-16D electronic warfare aircraft, suggesting that it may have entered service or was at least being integrated into the service’s broader air combat architecture. A screencap from an earlier video showing a GJ-11 flying alongside a J-16D and a J-20. PLA screencap Development and testing of the GJ-11 have been underway for years, with notable activity at China’s secretive Malan test facility in Xinjiang. Satellite imagery reviewed by TWZ has documented repeated, and at times near-daily, GJ-11 activity there, including multiple aircraft operating together. The deployment of three GJ-11s to Shigatse in Tibet between August and September 2025 provided an additional indication that the program was moving beyond test work toward operational evaluation. Two GJ-11s seen on the ramp at Malan on July 12, 2024. PHOTO © 2024 PLANET LABS INC. ALL RIGHTS RESERVED. REPRINTED BY PERMISSION Another image circulating on Chinese social media shows three additional GJ-11s parked alongside another example of the same type. Three GJ-11s in a hangar. PLA screencap Another hangar view with likely a fourth GJ-11 just visible on the right. PLA screencap According to Andreas Rupprecht, an expert on Chinese aviation and contributor to TWZ , numbers that can be seen on the drones themselves likely point to these aircraft being low-rate initial production (LRIP) examples. And what’s even more interesting is that, for the first time, numbers are clearly visible which – and I’m going to go out on a limb here – I believe are not serial numbers but rather design numbers. The numbers 0003, 0011 and 0012 are visible, so these are probably LRIP aircraft. pic.twitter.com/zH2D2Narr9 — @Rupprecht_A (@RupprechtDeino) November 10, 2026 The new releases come less than a month after China announced that the GJ-21 naval derivative had completed its first launch and recovery aboard the new Type 076 amphibious assault ship Sichuan , which is equipped with an electromagnetic catapult and arresting gear. The milestone would pave the way for the PLA Navy to field a shipborne stealth UCAV for strike and reconnaissance missions. However, China has yet to release actual footage of the claimed operation, leaving it independently unverified. The Type 076 amphibious assault ship Sichuan seen leaving Hudong-Zhonghua Shipyard for its first sea trials. Government of the People’s Republic of China The broader significance of the GJ-11 lies in the fact that it’s a genuine UCAV, not simply a loyal wingman designed to accompany a crewed fighter . Free of the endurance limitations imposed by a human crew, a platform of this class could likely offer at least twice the combat radius of a comparable crewed fighter. More importantly, it is intended to have the autonomy to conduct tactical missions independently, as well as operate alongside crewed aircraft. That opens up the possibility of extending China’s strike and reconnaissance reach considerably beyond what its existing low-observable crewed combat aircraft can achieve. The GJ-11’s flying-wing configuration, internal weapons bays, and emphasis on signature reduction suggest a platform approaching the very-low-observable (VLO) category. At the same time, China is now openly fielding a capability that the United States has conspicuously failed to bring into public operational service. In the late 2000s and early 2010s, the United States appeared to be leading the way in stealth UCAV development, with programs such as the Boeing Phantom Ray , X-45 , and X-47B demonstrating the potential of autonomous, long-range penetrating aircraft. Yet those ambitions effectively disappeared from the publicly acknowledged force-development agenda. The Pentagon has instead concentrated on lower-end and less capable Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA), generally designed to operate in conjunction with crewed fighters . Northrop Grumman’s X-47B UCAV demonstrator. U.S. Navy Northrop Grumman’s much larger X-47B that also featured a ‘cranked kite’ planform. USN As we argued in our earlier examinations of the American UCAV gap , the absence of a publicly acknowledged, sizeable force of independent, long-range stealth combat drones remains a significant weakness in U.S. airpower planning. Classified programs may exist, and the U.S. military certainly operates highly sophisticated stealthy uncrewed reconnaissance platforms , but even a small clandestine combat capability would be unlikely to make a decisive difference in a major, sustained conflict. China, meanwhile, is moving towards making this class of aircraft a central part of its military inventory. Important questions about the GJ-11 remain, particularly regarding its actual weapons load, various specifications, its degree of autonomy, and its ability to operate in coordination with crewed fighters. However, the latest official coverage provides the clearest indication yet of how China intends to employ its stealth UCAV in a future conflict, and sheds a little more light on the Mystery Dragon. title: 澳洲黑产猖獗，一女子竟卖过 1150 分驾照
summary: 墨尔本场就是今晚啦，抓紧购票！ 澳洲一些司机为了保住驾照，花钱找陌生人顶替自己承担违章记录。 这类交易在Facebook群组、Messenger和WhatsApp等平台公开招揽，已形成相当活跃且屡禁不止的灰色产业链。报价能达每分80澳元（5分以上的每分50澳元），罚款金额买家自担。 在部分个人私下交易或管理更严的地区（如首都领地），单分价格甚至被炒到500至1000澳元，仅2026年上半年，ACT政府就收到了近2.5万份声称“违章时非车主本人驾驶”的法定声明，其中混杂了大量虚
content: 墨尔本场就是今晚啦，抓紧购票！ 澳洲一些司机为了保住驾照，花钱找陌生人顶替自己承担违章记录。 这类交易在Facebook群组、Messenger和WhatsApp等平台公开招揽，已形成相当活跃且屡禁不止的灰色产业链。报价能达每分80澳元（5分以上的每分50澳元），罚款金额买家自担。 在部分个人私下交易或管理更严的地区（如首都领地），单分价格甚至被炒到500至1000澳元，仅2026年上半年，ACT政府就收到了近2.5万份声称“违章时非车主本人驾驶”的法定声明，其中混杂了大量虚假申报。 在昆州的一起案件中，一名27岁女子在2022至2026年期间替其他司机累计背下过约1150分，涉及1266张交通罚单，罚款总额约62万澳元。 早期，部分州的系统自动化拦截机制并不完善。 该女子不是低调行事，而是在社交媒体上公开发布广告、明码标价经营这种“花钱买分/顶替罚单”的业务，最终促使了后台的自动化风控预警系统的升级。 她于今年9月被捕，面临欺诈指控。 还有一昆州男子通过类似方式牟利超过10万澳元，涉及695分罚分，多次冒用其他人的身份承担罚单，已承认多项罪名，在今年6月被判处3年监禁。 还有部分卖家声称拥有政府系统的内部账号，可快速完成违章转移，但目前没有他们真的具备相关权限的证据。 尤其对于依赖开车谋生的网约车司机、卡车司机或偏远地区居民来说，停牌意味着失业，这一人群中的"需求旺盛"。与中国可以通过学习交规考试来减免记分不同，在澳洲一旦扣分落定，除了等待3年的清零外，几乎没有合法的消分途径。 过去，海外游客或部分临时签证持有者使用国际驾照时，澳洲系统无法直接吊销其母国驾照，导致许多留学生或即将离境的背包客把“卖分”当成离境前的套现手段。 警方表示，这些交易让原本应该被吊销驾照的司机继续上路，可给其他道路使用者带来危险。 澳洲各州对交通罚分和虚假申报的具体法律规定有所不同，但无论是找人顶替的司机（不论有偿无偿），还是明知自己不是驾驶者却"认罚"的人，都可能面临刑事指控。社交媒体聊天记录和转账记录都可能成为证据。 在新州和昆州为例，在法定声明中作假（虚假指认）最高可面临1.1万澳元（企业高达2.2万澳元）的罚款；如果涉及反复替人顶包牟利，警方会以欺诈罪（Fraud）或妨碍司法公正罪（Perverting the course of justice）起诉，最高可判处5至10年监禁。 多州此前已收紧海外驾照转换政策，并成立了专门的“记分欺诈工作组”，通过银行流水，驾驶车辆类型不匹配，聊天记录，以及与边防局的出入境数据（顶包者当时可能根本不在澳洲）比对，对买分和卖分的双方进行追责。

content:
菲律宾与中国在南海问题上的裂痕加深海峡时报
菲律宾与中国在南海问题上的分歧加深
立即注册：深入了解亚洲的快速发展
资料照片：2026 年 7 月 20 日，中国海岸警卫队和菲律宾海军舰艇在南海仁爱礁发生冲突，截取自讲义视频。杰·塔里拉（Jay Tarriela）来自 X/讲义来自 REUTERS/档案照片
发表于 2026 年 11 月 15 日 1:24
更新于 2026 年 11 月 15 日 1:24
马尼拉，11 月 15 日 - 在菲律宾总统小费迪南德·马科斯 (Ferdinand Marcos Jr) 的领导下，马尼拉和北京之间的关系恶化，马尼拉转向支持菲律宾与中国的海上争端的美国。
以下是过去两年中导致菲律宾和中国之间紧张局势升级的关键事件的时间表：
1月6日——菲律宾部署船只和飞机在专属经济区监视中国最大的海警船。
2 月 18 日——马尼拉指责中国海军在黄岩岛附近进行危险的飞越；北京纠纷。
3 月 28 日——卫星图像显示，中国在黄岩岛周围部署了两架轰 6 轰炸机。
5 月 5 日——菲律宾对中国科考船提出质疑，称其在伊罗戈海岸进行非法海洋调查。
8 月 4 日——菲律宾和印度海军首次在南海联合航行。
8月12日——马尼拉批评中国在黄岩岛的“危险举动”；称他们导致了中国船只相撞。
8 月 13 日——中国表示驱逐了在黄岩岛附近航行的美国驱逐舰；美国海军表示其行动符合国际法。
9月10日——中国批准在黄岩岛建立国家级自然保护区。
9月16日——中国海警在黄岩岛附近向菲律宾船只发射水炮；菲律宾指责北京的“侵略”行为导致一人受伤。
10月12日——马尼拉指责中国海警在菲律宾占领的中业岛附近撞击并发射高压水枪袭击菲律宾渔船。
1 月 20 日——中国称其驱逐了“非法侵入”黄岩岛领空的菲律宾飞机。
1月27日——菲律宾和美国军队在黄岩岛附近举行联合军事演习。
2 月 27 日——菲律宾与盟国美国和日本一起在南中国海举行海上演习；中国也在争议海域进行了类似的演习。
3 月 4 日——菲律宾逮捕了涉嫌为中国从事间谍活动的菲律宾公民。
3 月 18 日——中国在黄岩岛上空驱逐两架菲律宾飞机。
3 月 20 日——菲律宾指责中国海军舰艇将火控雷达瞄准其一艘船只。
3月29日——北京和马尼拉恢复能源合作谈判后，中国在黄岩岛周围进行海军、空军和海岸警卫队巡逻。
4 月 9 日——菲律宾海岸警卫队指责中国军队在南海直接向其飞机发射照明弹。
4月25日——马尼拉和华盛顿举行军演时，中国在吕宋岛附近海域举行实弹演习。
4月27日——菲律宾和美国在南海附近的巴拉望省举行演习。
5月2日——美国、菲律宾在台湾附近省份部署反舰导弹系统进行军演。
5 月 7 日——菲律宾称中国船只在南海富含天然气的礼乐滩附近进行“非法”研究。
6 月 9 日——菲律宾就南海浮动结构对中国采取外交行动。

Rift deepens between the Philippines, China over South China Sea

FILE PHOTO: Chinese Coast Guard and Philippine Navy vessels during an encounter at Second Thomas Shoal in the South China Sea July 20, 2026 in this screen grab from handout video. Jay Tarriela via X/Handout via REUTERS /File Photo
Published Nov 15, 2026, 01:24 PM
Updated Nov 15, 2026, 01:24 PM
MANILA, Nov 15 - Relations between Manila and Beijing have soured under Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr, with Manila pivoting back towards the United States, which supports the Southeast Asian nation in its maritime disputes with China.
Here is a timeline of key events over the last two years that have escalated tensions between the Philippines and China:
JANUARY 6 – Philippines deploys ships, aircraft to monitor China's largest coast guard vessel in exclusive economic zone.
FEBRUARY 18 – Manila accuses Chinese navy of a dangerous flyby near Scarborough Shoal; Beijing disputes.
MARCH 28 – China deploys two H-6 bombers around Scarborough Shoal, satellite images show.
MAY 5 – Philippines challenges Chinese research ship over what it says was an illegal marine survey off Ilocos coast.
AUGUST 4 – Philippine, Indian navies sail together for first time in South China Sea.
AUGUST 12 – Manila criticises Chinese "dangerous manoeuvres" at Scarborough Shoal; says they led to Chinese ship collision.
AUGUST 13 – China says it drove away US destroyer that sailed near Scarborough Shoal; US Navy says its action was in line with international law.
SEPTEMBER 10 – China approves creation of a national nature reserve at Scarborough Shoal.
SEPTEMBER 16 – Chinese coast guard fires water cannon at Philippine ships near Scarborough Shoal; Philippines accuses Beijing of "aggressive" action that injured one person.
OCTOBER 12 – Manila accuses Chinese coast guard of ramming and firing water cannon at Philippine fisheries vessels near Philippine-occupied Thitu Island.
JANUARY 20 – China says it drove away Philippine aircraft that "illegally intruded" into the airspace over Scarborough Shoal.
JANUARY 27 – Philippine, US militaries hold joint military drills near Scarborough Shoal.
FEBRUARY 27 – Philippines joins maritime drills with allies US and Japan in the South China Sea; China also conducts similar drills in the disputed sea.
MARCH 4 – Philippines apprehends Filipino nationals suspected of spying for China.
MARCH 18 – China expels two Philippine aircraft above Scarborough Shoal.
MARCH 20 – Philippines accuses Chinese navy ship of directing its fire-control radar against one of its vessels.
MARCH 29 – China conducts naval, air and coast guard patrols around Scarborough Shoal after Beijing and Manila resume talks on energy cooperation.
APRIL 9 – Philippine Coast Guard accuses Chinese forces of directly firing flares at its aircraft in the South China Sea.
APRIL 25 – China holds live-fire drills in waters near Luzon island as Manila and Washington stage war games.
APRIL 27 – Philippines, US stage drills in Palawan province near South China Sea.
MAY 2 – US, Philippines deploy anti-ship missile system in province near Taiwan for war games.
MAY 7 – Philippines says Chinese vessel conducted "illegal" research near gas-rich Reed Bank in South China Sea.
JUNE 9 – Philippines takes diplomatic action against China over floating structure in South China Sea.
JUNE 11 – China announces sanctions against Philippine Defence Secretary Gilberto Teodoro, saying he had "repeatedly made erroneous remarks concerning China."
JULY 20 – Philippines says Chinese coast guard personnel struck Philippine navy sailor in the head using a wooden baton during an encounter in the South China Sea.
JULY 23 – Manila says Chinese coast guard vessel fired water cannon at a Philippine government fisheries vessel at the Scarborough Shoal in the South China Sea.
SEPTEMBER 18 – Philippines says China coast guard rammed Philippine boat on refuelling mission.
SEPTEMBER 25 – Philippines accuses China of obstructing a resupply mission to troops at Second Thomas Shoal.
OCTOBER 16 – Philippines chides China's ambassador over his "thinly veiled threat" of force.
OCTOBER 19 – Philippines says it summoned China's ambassador to Manila over remarks conveying "threat." REUTERS
